image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey Cafe Amazon coffee shop building, detailed front elevation with a glazed frontage and glass door under a deep green fascia carrying the yellow-green Cafe Amazon wordmark and parrot device on a backlit sign, timber slat cladding below the window sill and a slim timber-edged canopy, plain warm cream painted side and rear walls in a single flat off-white tone clearly lighter than the background, with a service door, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: forest green painted panel timber slats and backlit acrylic sign face at the front, plate glass, flat warm cream painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless MID-DARK neutral grey (#606060), distinctly darker than every part of the building so the object reads as a clean cut-out against it. The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: Cafe Amazon / OR. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.92 -- not a pass self-score. 2200/16000 triangles, 11/12 draw calls, 7/8 materials, 11/16 unique geometries, 5 textures, factory ~110 ms. Plain glazing by brief; the mullion rhythm, door width, pilaster width, batten count, canopy top, condenser scale and deck tone each corrected against a measurement of the plate.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at exactly 8.00 x 4.60 x 7.00 m against the declared 8 x 4.6 x 7: wall 7.44 m wide plus the canopy's 0.46 m -X overhang, canopy nose at z 3.45. Front and +X elevations rectified at 150 px/m (scratch/_ca/front_rect_grid.png, side_rect_grid.png); Meshy h/w 0.573 against the declared 0.575. check-coplanar clean at 0.001 m after two pairs the canopy's move out of the frame merge exposed (dado backing at x -3.50, corner return at z 3.06) were separated.
featureReviews.notes: Third build. Envelope unchanged from the second (0.91); the massing was already right. The proxy reads the depth 13% shallower than the module; the module is the kit's shared retail envelope and wins.

featureReviews.evidence: Toucan badge (Nano Banana 2 front-on redraw of the plate's sign crop, sign/nb_roundel.png) now 1.05 m wide at world x -2.59, y 3.72 -- the rectified front measures it 0.48..1.55 m (1.07 x 0.97 m), the second build's 0.95 was 10% under -- and the 'Cafe Amazon' wordmark 2.79 m long with a 10 mm stroke on the Ubuntu Bold so it carries the plate's rounded heavy weight, baked into one 2048x320 strip on the fascia's #3D6644 (scratch/_ca/bake_sign.py). Front render (renders/beauty-000.png) shows badge and wordmark filling the band as the plate does.
featureReviews.notes: The plate's wordmark slopes down to the right with the canopy line and the band bottom; that is the generated plate's projective inconsistency and the build sets it level.

featureReviews.evidence: Deep green block over the right bay (y 2.2..4.5) wrapping +X as a 0.6 m return; and the pilaster between the left glazing and the corner bay is now 0.87 m wide (world 1.12..1.99): on the 2x zoom of the rectified front the left run's glass ends at 4.97 m and green fills 4.97..5.9 m. The second build had a 0.37 m pilaster there and ran the glass 0.5 m further. All six green boards sample one baked strip: one material, one draw call.
featureReviews.notes: Corner block, return, pilasters and band read as one green (#3D6644) in the render.

featureReviews.evidence: Layout re-read off a column-luma scan of the rectified front (rows 440..500, dark verticals at luma 12..27): door leaf 0.61..1.57 m -> 0.92 m wide on a hinge at world -3.02 (was 0.80 at -3.10), two mullions at 2.67 and 3.87 m -> world -1.02 and -0.10 giving panes of 1.00 / 0.92 / 1.22 m (the second build had three mullions plus a wide stile at a rhythm the plate does not have), corner window and return unchanged. The glass is PLAIN tinted glazing on the brief -- no interior image -- a flat cool blue-green gradient with a soft sheen (sign/bake_glass.py) held on chroma: rendered panes measure (67,86,89) sat 0.25 and (72,95,98) sat 0.27, and the turntable gate passed at all four azimuths with no holes (largest enclosed component 325 px, an edge).
featureReviews.notes: The second build projected the plate's own shopfront behind the glass; the owner rejected it -- a flat photograph on a flat pane slides against the built frames as the camera orbits. Rendered without it the frame rhythm is what carries the shopfront's identity, which is why the mullion count was worth correcting.

featureReviews.evidence: 23 batten courses (38 mm at 45.65 mm pitch) in three runs over a dark backing, where the plate's corner-return zoom (scratch/_ca dado crop) counts ~23 grooves over the 1.05 m; the second build's nine 95 mm courses read as planks. The canopy is a pale blue-grey slab (#8C989C; the plate's slab top samples (96,108,122)..(150,160,165)) with a 0.12 m timber edge board proud of its nose and -X end, leaving a centimetre of pale edge above and below as the plate shows -- the second build carried it as a dark slab under a 0.18 m board. 72 boxes, eight vertex tones, one draw call.
featureReviews.notes: Tones bracket the plate's lit (174,123,78) and shaded (82,68,55) timber.

featureReviews.evidence: Rectified +X elevation: one cream door 1.0 x 2.25 m at 4.0..5.0 m from the front corner. Built at z -2.10..-1.10, recessed 0.12 m in a reveal (shell boxes leave the pocket), the leaf in the wall material as the plate shows, with a near-black reveal frame and lever so it reads.
featureReviews.notes: Unchanged from the second build. Not mirrored onto the unobserved -X wall.

featureReviews.evidence: Three instanced split condensers at a uniform 1.3 scale of the MK unit (1.17 x 0.86 x 0.44 casing, tops 0.92 m over the deck) at x -2.62 / -1.00 / 0.62 with 0.45 m gaps along the rear upstand: the plate's roof zoom shows units about 2.5x the upstand's height and wider than tall, and the 0.66 m unit of the second build read as toy-sized. The deck is authored #868280 to render at 0.87 of the cream wall (measured 156 vs 179 on the hero) against the plate's 0.84 (183 vs 217); the second build's near-white deck rendered at 0.94.
featureReviews.notes: Units carry the MK geometry (dark front plate, fan disc behind guard bars, side louvre); the plate's grille is a larger dark square, a difference at prop distance only.
